title: Hash Embedding Mirror importance codes
hypothesis: For functions aligned to a pair of hash-selected component tables, one angular importance coordinate per token can replace two native per-token scalar weights at no material quality loss and fewer actual serialized bytes.
physical_object: two shared hash component tables and a shared output classifier
mirror_coordinate: one persisted angle m_i per token; e_i=cos(m_i)e[h1(i)]+sin(m_i)e[h2(i)]

model.data: Synthetic token-to-next-class lookup. Each seed creates two fixed hash buckets per token and two teacher component banks; a task-specific unit-norm two-coordinate importance vector combines the selected component embeddings, followed by a fixed teacher readout to produce hard class labels. Training/validation/test examples are disjoint token draws; the same 128-token vocabulary is evaluated in each split.

controls: independent per-token embedding table plus shared classifier
native two-table Hash Embedding with two direct importance coefficients per token
shared two-table Hash Embedding with fixed equal importance weights
shared two-table Hash Embedding with one Mirror angle per token
development_gate_before_fresh: Both development seeds: independent accuracy >=0.80; Mirror within 0.02 absolute accuracy and 0.05 NLL of native Hash Embedding; Mirror serialized bytes <=0.60x independent and <=0.90x native hash; collided-token accuracy within 0.02 of native; serialized-state CPU throughput >=0.90x native; direct coefficient control must not match the Mirror point at lower/equal bytes. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh seeds satisfy quality, byte, collision and runtime gates and Mirror improves the native Hash Embedding quality-byte frontier; exact payload hash/load/replay.
failure_gate: Either development seed misses any registered gate or native two-scalar importance matches Mirror at comparable/lower bytes. Fresh remains sealed.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload after reload
paid_objects: independent embedding table or both hashed component tables
all per-token scalar weights or Mirror angles
hash seeds, table size, and lookup metadata

boundaries: no natural language or realistic large-vocabulary claim
token count and possible hash combinations are not independent capacity
fresh seeds remain sealed unless every development gate passes
